offers_products.reason: Sells electricity and natural gas as regulated utility service, not as a separate manufactured product line.

offers_services.reason: Regulated electric and natural gas utility service to customers across several states.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Residential electric and gas customers make up much of its utility customer base.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Commercial, industrial and wholesale power customers, plus municipalities, buy electricity and gas.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing monthly utility billing for electricity and gas service.

cyclical_demand.reason: Essential heating and power demand is hard to postpone in a downturn.

people_delivered.reason: Service depends on power plants, pipelines and grids, not mainly on staff time.

large_customers.reason: Mostly households and small commercial customers; large enterprises are a smaller share.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs generation plants, transmission lines and gas pipelines with continuing capital investment.

notes: Regulated electric and gas utility; energy is delivered as a utility service, so products are marked no.
